name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Crane, Pierce, and Lounge go with Cooking, Sleeping, and Walking, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Ballroom goes with Walking; Conservatory goes with Bathing; Lounge goes with Sleeping.
Cooking goes with none of Crane, Holloway, or Lounge.
Between Blackwood and Crane, one goes with Conservatory and the other with Bathing.
Either Lounge goes with Crane or Ballroom goes with Pierce.
